column_description: Unique identifier for each metric entry.
Reference to the country. may be NULL.
Date for which the metrics are recorded. may be NULL.
Smoothed rate of new deaths per million population. may be NULL.
Estimated reproduction rate of the virus. may be NULL.
Smoothed rate of new tests per thousand population. may be NULL.
Percentage of positive test results. may be NULL.
Average number of tests per confirmed case. may be NULL.
Percentage of population fully vaccinated. may be NULL.
Smoothed rate of new vaccinations per million population. may be NULL.
Index representing the stringency of public health measures. may be NULL.
Alternative representation of percentage of population fully vaccinated. may be NULL.
Total number of deaths up to the recorded date. may be NULL.
Total number of confirmed cases up to the recorded date. may be NULL.
Total number of tests conducted up to the recorded date. may be NULL.
Total number of vaccinations administered up to the recorded date. may be NULL.
Date when a significant percentage of the population is fully vaccinated. may be NULL.
Source of the data (e.g., WHO, CDC, local health authorities). always exactly one of 'WHO', 'CDC', 'local health authorities'. may be NULL.
